Best choice of vegetarian food in the city
Feb 2026 • Couples
We stopped at this restaurant for lunch after a long and very hot walk. It was like a little oasis. We sat in the courtyard area in the middle of the Restaurant which has a beautiful pond cool green leaves and a lovely relaxing atmosphere amidst the madness is that is Ho Chi Minh City!
The variety of food options was incredible – so lovely to find so many vegetarian choices that you don’t know which want to pick. 
In the end we chose to delicious salads and some spring rolls to share.
The staff were lovely. The two waitresses that served us were both so friendly and helpful (one was called Bella but I’m sorry I don’t know the other ladies name).
Couldn’t recommend this highly enough just wonderful.

A quiet lunch after a long meeting
Jan 2026 • Solo
I enjoy every visit to the Shamballa Vegetarian Restaurant and Lounge. I drop in alone sometimes, other times with friends. My non-vegetarian friends enjoy their meals. The extensive, seasonal menu can make it difficult to choose just one or two dishes. I like sitting quietly in the calm atmosphere and considering what to eat and drink. It's a nice contrast to the bustling city outside. I especially like the Nem rolls, the various mushroom rolls, and the soups. The smoothies and juices are full-flavored and delicious, the coffee and the teas are good. When I'm in the mood, I get a mocktail or a cocktail. I especially like the Muoi Tieu Chanh, the salt, pepper, lime mocktail.

Go To Spot for Vegetarians/Vegans in Saigon!
Aug 2024 • Family
Absolutely beautiful aesthetics. Right when you walk in, there's a pond with fish and another in the back. There's just the right amount of space if you happen to come with a large party.

We came on 9/3/2024 and received extremely excellent service from Thanh Bac. She was very polite and incredibly attentive. When she noticed that I was having difficulty drinking my macadamia and brown rice latte she immediately came over with a tray of bigger straws and asked if I wanted to switch it out. She came several times to check in on us without being pushy and always greeted us with a smile. Sadly this was the best service we've received from a restaurant during our trip to Vietnam.

As for the food:
- Macadamia Brown Rice Latte (5/5) - lite and refreshing with just the right amount of sweetness
- Fresh Passion Fruit and Orange Juice (5/5) - a little sour but 100% fresh. It came in its own little bottle that we pour out to a cup with some liquid sugar - you can adjust the sweetness/tang to your liking
- Nam Rac Muoi Xanh [Green Salted Crispy Mushrooms] (5/5) -
- Mien Xao Noi Dat [Clay Pot Glass Noodles] (4.5/5) - aside from some of the noodles drying out because they were left at the end of the pot instead of properly being placed inside, this hit the spot if you're craving glass noodles
- Banh Hoi Nem Lui [Woven Noodles & Grilled Nem] (5/5) - you wouldn't believe this wasn't meat. had all the right flavors of nem. perfectly cooked and succulent (normally this can be slightly dry if cooked improperly) but it was excellent

Overall, excellent spot for vegans/vegetarians traveling to Vietnam. Would 100% recommend and give a shoutout to Thanh Bac for us!

After I had finished that, I was about to order another drink when the proprietor, Ms Jade, walked nearby my table. I started to chat with her and asked her if I could buy her a coffee. She sat and ordered a tea (at no charge) for each of us. We talked for a bit (because of the rain, it was well past lunchtime and quite some time before dinner) during her break. She told me about her three restaurants and also about Vietnam. A nice bonus for a lone diner! I will definitely take my wife when we visit Vietnam again!
